subject: Mutual action milestones & packaging adjustments — Horizon Health pilot
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & next steps for pilot (observability + support asks)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) for the 90-day pilot focused on: ingestion, latency targets, quality checks, and the observability/retention & premium support add-ons you asked about. Key asks from your side are highlighted in column C.

High-level proposal:
- Week 0–2: sandbox onboarding (account, VPC peering, test dataset)
- Week 3–6: evaluation runs (sample workload, latency SLO 200–300ms, quality gates)
- Week 7–12: ramp to 3k monthly request equivalent, production validation

Commercial note: we propose a pilot credit pool ($15k) and a deferred commitment model where Horizon converts to a reserved commit if the MAP milestones are met — we outline a ramped commit schedule and associated discount tiers in the Pricing_Tiers_Appendix.

I attached: MAP_HorizonHealth_v2.xlsx, SOW_Draft.pdf, Pricing_Tiers_Appendix.csv.

Please review and let me know which rows you want to adjust. If this looks reasonable, can we aim to lock the MAP by next Tuesday (10 Aug) so procurement has time to review?

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_HorizonHealth_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 97KB)]
[attachment: SOW_Draft.pdf (pdf, 44KB)]

From: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@horizonhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps for pilot (observability + support asks)

Logan —

Thanks. Quick read-through notes:
- MAP timeline looks fine, but procurement will push back on net-60 billing unless we sign a short-term PO. Can we accept net-30 for pilot invoicing?
- Observability: we need 90-day retention for traces/alerts (your standard is 30). Is there an add-on price for extended retention?
- Premium support: we'd like 24x7 on-call during the ramp window. What's the delta for escalation SLAs?

I'll get procurement on an initial review. If you can send a version with the observability and support options priced out, that will speed things up.

—Alex
Alex Garcia
Dir. Data & Analytics | Horizon Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP — pricing for retention & support

Quick internal:

Logan — I reviewed Horizon's asks. Two levers to propose:
1) Observability retention: standard 30 days included. Add-on tiers: 60d (+10% pilot price), 90d (+18%). Could also offer 90d as a trial for the full pilot period for free if they commit to a minimum 6-month reserved capacity at conversion.
2) Premium support: bronze (business hrs) included, silver (24x5) +8% of monthly run-rate, gold (24x7 + priority escalation) +18% — for pilots we can include silver for the first 30 days.

Also: we should attach an updated Pricing_Tiers_Appendix that maps commit ramp -> discount bands (3%, 7%, 12% at $X monthly commitments). Karthik, can you confirm the discount math and add the add-on credits (we usually give $2k–$5k in platform credits for pilots that convert within 90 days)?

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP — pricing for retention & support

On the discount/commit math:
- Pilot credit: $15,000 applied to initial invoices.
- Conversion tiers (monthly committed spend):
  * $25k/mo -> 3% discount + $2k onboarding credit
  * $50k/mo -> 7% discount + $4k onboarding credit + 30d extended retention included
  * $100k/mo -> 12% discount + $10k onboarding credit + 90d extended retention + gold support trial 30d

Observability add-on pricing (if not converted to a reserved tier):
- 60d retention: flat $1,800/month
- 90d retention: flat $3,200/month

Premium support delta (pilot pricing):
- Silver (24x5): $1,200/month for pilot
- Gold (24x7): $3,400/month for pilot (includes 1 incident per month triage)

I'll update Pricing_Tiers_Appendix.csv and push a new MAP version that explicitly links milestones to the conversion trigger (e.g., sustained 95% pass rate on the quality gate across 2 weeks => conversion option window opens).

Karthik
Revenue Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@horizonhealth.com>, Procurement_HH <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated MAP + pricing appendix (requested retention/support options)

Alex / Procurement —

Thanks for the notes. Attached is an updated MAP (v2) that:
- Adds line items for 60/90-day observability retention (rows 12–13) and the support tiers (rows 14–15) with pilot pricing.
- Ties the conversion trigger to MAP milestone M6: sustained production-quality pass for two consecutive weeks.
- Includes the revised conversion discount bands from Karthik.

If procurement wants net-30 on pilot invoices, we can do that for Horizon. DocuSign link in related_links is ready for signature; I’m also happy to run a short 30-minute call with procurement to walk the SOW.

[attachment: MAP_HorizonHealth_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 104KB)]
[attachment: Pricing_Tiers_Appendix.csv (csv, 5KB)]

Appreciate the quick turnaround — can we aim to have an executed MAP + SOW before EOD Friday 21 Aug?

Best,
Logan

From: Claire Jones <c.jones@horizonhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + pricing appendix (requested retention/support options)

Logan / Team —

Procurement reviewed the updated MAP. Good news: the execs approved the pilot subject to the following conditions before signing the SOW:
1) Net-30 for pilot invoicing (confirmed).
2) 90-day retention for traces/alerts included at no charge for the 90-day pilot period (they want the visibility during evaluation).
3) Gold support trial for first 30 days (we will evaluate uplift to paid gold on conversion).
4) Signed MAP + SOW and PO on file by COB 3 Sep — otherwise they will defer to Q4 vendor reviews.

We are comfortable moving forward under those terms. Please convert the DocuSign to reflect the 90-day retention waiver and the gold support 30-day trial, and send to my attention (Claire Jones).

Regards,
Claire Jones
CFO (interim) | Horizon Health
[attachment: Procurement_Response_20260830.pdf (pdf, 18KB)]
